dishes.name: Maultaschen
dishes.desc: Large filled pasta squares with minced meat, spinach and onion, served in broth or pan-fried with egg. The best-known Swabian dish.

dishes.name: Lentils with spaetzle
dishes.desc: Stewed lentils with vinegar, soft egg noodles and a pair of Saitenwürstle sausages. Stuttgart's everyday signature plate.

dishes.name: Gaisburger Marsch
dishes.desc: Beef stew with potatoes and spätzle, topped with onions. Named after the Gaisburg district of Stuttgart.

dishes.name: Zwiebelrostbraten
dishes.desc: Pan-fried roast beef with a rich gravy and crispy onions, served with spätzle. A Swabian tavern classic.

dishes.name: Filderkraut
dishes.desc: Pointed cabbage from the Filder plateau, braised with bacon or served as a side. Stuttgart's own protected local cabbage.
